# ANotes

> ANotes is a voice notes app. It turns speech into text on the phone itself, with no internet and no account. Notes and recordings stay on the phone, as plain Markdown.

- Platform: Android.
- Price: free. A paid version with extra looks (skins) is planned. Speech models are always free.
- Works offline: once a model is downloaded, dictation, reading aloud, storage and search work in airplane mode.
- Dictation languages: English, Russian and others; each model lists the languages it understands.
- Every recording stays on its note: play it, share it, or transcribe it again.
- Reads notes aloud with the phone's own voice, and keeps the place.
- No account, no sync, no analytics, no ads.
- In testing, not in the public app yet: AI features that run on the phone (tidy a dictation, make a checklist, sum up or translate a note).
